en.p: On a plane $\alpha$ there is a trapezoid ABCD with $\overline{\mathrm{AB}}=\overline{\mathrm{CD}}=\overline{\mathrm{AD}}=2$ and $\angle\mathrm{ABC}=\angle\mathrm{BCD}=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$. For two points P, Q on plane $\alpha$ satisfying the following conditions, find the value of $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{CP}}\cdot\overrightarrow{\mathrm{DQ}}$. [4 points]
